question: What is the scientific name of the banyan tree, a large evergreen tree of Asia characterized by its trunk-like aerial roots?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ficus benghalensis.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The banyan tree is also known as the Indian banyan or Bengal fig.**
 
• It is one of the largest trees in the world and can grow up to** 30 meters tall.**
 
• The banyan tree is considered sacred in Hinduism and is often planted** near temples and other religious sites.**
 
• Its aerial roots can grow into secondary trunks, making it appear as if there are multiple trees growing from a single root system.
 
• Ficus benghalensis' is the scientific name of Banyan__.
 
• It is also known as the **banyan fig and Indian Banyan.**
 
• **Banyan is a large, fast-growing, evergreen tree that is widely found across tropical and subtropical areas of the world.**
 
• These trees begin growing on other trees as epiphytes and they** eventually mature, completely killing the host tree.**
 
• It produces large numbers of seeds that can be dispersed by both native and exotic birds.
 __
 
• **Family: Moraceae**
 
• **Order: Rosales**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Gossypium herbaceum **is the scientific name for the **cotton plant**, which is used to produce cotton fiber.
 
• **Santalum album**, is the scientific name for **sandalwood, a fragrant wood used in perfumes, cosmetics, and traditional medicine.**
 
• ** Ananas comosus**, is the scientific name for the **pineapple, a tropical fruit with a sweet, juicy flesh.**
